description.en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

description.zh:
Web fallback行为类型。

0：返回指定文本

1：跳转到指定页面
description.en:
The type of the web fallback behavior.

0: returns the specified text

1: redirects to the specified page

The encoding type.

0: plain text

1: JSON

Specifies whether to enable the rule.

0: disables the rule.

1: enables the rule.
The unique ID of the gateway.
The ID of the throttling rule.
The overall queries per second (QPS) threshold.
